Commentary.Commentary: The Kiwi bowling was decent! Their captain was the star. Seth Rance too had a decent outing. Santner and Sodhi were on the expensive side but the pacers who kept taking wickets covered up for it. The total is a challenging one but New Zealand scored a few more in the last game so they would back themselves. However, Sri Lanka know the opposition is missing Ross Taylor so they too would feel they can defend this. Will the series be levelled or will New Zealand win it? Stay tuned to find out in  a while.

The innings started really well for the Lankans. They got off to a brisk start but then were pulled back as the two openers were dismissed in quick succession. Fernando and Dickwella then steadied the ship with a very good stand but just as the two started to take the game away from New Zealand, the visitors once again got back-to-back wickets of Fernando and Shanaka. However, the Lankan batters did not let the momentum slip away. They kept scoring quickly but also lost wickets at regular intervals which saw them get to a decent total.

Not sure which team will be the happier of the two at the moment heading into the break! New Zealand though walk back with smiles on their faces so one would say they will be happy with where they stand at the moment. However, the wicket does not seem the same as the last one, it is a touch slow so Sri Lanka will also not be disappointed with their effort.

OUT! RUN OUT! A dot to end! A full ball outside off, Dananjaya swings but misses. They try to steal a bye but AD is late in taking off. The keeper, Tim Seifert lobs it to the bowler, Seth Rance who takes the bails off at his end. So two dots to end but still 10 from the over and a couple of wickets too. SRI LANKA END WITH 161!
Lasith Malinga comes out to bat for just a single delivery.
OUT! Udana holes out! He will be disappointed here as this one was a full toss. He does not get any timing on it and it goes high up in the air towards long off. Mitchell takes another one.

MISFIELD AND FOUR! This is so unlike New Zealand. They have been poor in the field today. Another full toss outside off, Udana mistimes it towards cover. Southee runs to his left and looks to stop it with a slide but fails to do so. It goes to the fence behind.

In the air... safe! Run out chance but the throw is not a good one. Two taken. Another slower one outside off, Udana swings hard but gets an outside edge towards third man. Colin de Grandhomme from point runs towards the ball and dives but does not get to it. Udana goes for the second but Akila responds late. The throw to the keeper is high. He leaps and takes it and then fires it to the bowler but by then, Dananjaya is in.
Another two! This is a length ball and it is a slower one on off, Udana hits it back past the bowler and takes two.

A couple to start the last! A full toss outside off, it is sliced past the point fielder. Munro in the deep runs to his left and fumbles. He loses sight of where the ball is but luckily for him, it stops before the ropes. Two taken.
Seth Rance to bowl the last over. He took a beating in the last over of the last game and would want to bowl a better last over.
Does so! Just a single to end! Slower ball outside off, Dananjaya hits it to mid off for one. End of a brilliant spell by Southee. His figures, 4-0-18-2.
Just a single! A full toss outside off, it is hit through covers for one. This is a top penultimate over. Needs to end it well.
One more dot! A slower one outside off, Udana fails to put bat on ball as he tries to drive.
Akila Dananjaya comes out to bat.

OUT! Taken! Southee's impressive night continues! This is a short ball outside off, Jayasuriya looks to heave it over the leg side but ends up slicing it high up in the air towards point. Daryl Mitchell there takes a simple catch. A good cameo from SJ comes to an end.
In the gap and a couple! One more slower one on middle, SJ pulls it through mid-wicket. The fielder in the deep runs to his right, dives and keeps it down to two. 150 up for Sri Lanka.
Lovely delivery! It is a slower ball outside off, Jayasuriya makes a leave thinking it was a wide but it was well in. A dot to begin.
Tim Southee to bowl the penultimate over of the innings. Impressive figures from him so far, 3-0-15-1.

He is off the mark straightaway! Two taken in the end! Sloppy from the Kiwis. Udana pushes this through covers and takes one. The throw is a wild one from the fielder in the deep and an overthrow is taken. 13 runs and a wicket from this over.
Isuru Udana is the new man in. A quick fire innings is what is expected from him.

OUT! TIMBER! A lucky wicket? Well, you could say so as this would have been a Free Hit had the previous ball been called a no ball. Nevertheless, New Zealand will be happy. It is fast and on a length and on off. It skids through. Hasaranga looks to guide it down to third man but that shot is never on. He misses and the ball hits the off pole. So Kuggeleijn is making a good comeback here. Needs to end it well though.
A dot! That was touch and go! Could have been given a no ball for height. A high full toss outside off. The batter slashes but misses. Replays show that was above the waist height.
A yorker now outside off, it is jammed down to third man for one. 11 from the first three balls now. This could end up being a huge over.
SIX! That is nailed! Wow! A short one and it is a slower ball. Shehan is ready for it. He smashes it over the square leg fence and bags a biggie.

FOUR! Brilliant shot! Innovation at its best! He brings out the reverse paddle scoop. Nails it and gets it over the short third man fielder for a boundary. Ideal start to the over, pressure on the bowler now.
Scott Kuggeleijn to bowl his last now! 3-0-25-1 his figures so far.

A single to end! This is shorter and down the leg side, it is pulled to deep backward square leg for one. An expensive end to Sodhi's spell, 11 from it. His figures today 4-0-34-1. Been expensive the leggie.
A half-stop and a run! This is floated up on off, it is hit hard back to the bowler. Sodhi dives to his left and only gets a hand to it. Can't stop a run.
Shorter again and outside off, Hasaranga once again manages to get it behind point and collects two.
FOUR! That is a poor, poor ball and it is put away! Short and wide outside off. Hasaranga reaches out for it. Gets it past point and bags a boundary.
Nicely played! This is short and outside off, WH guides it through point for two.
Brings the sweep shot out but hits it to deep square leg for only a single.
Ish Sodhi to bowl out! 3-0-23-1 figures for him.
Good running! A slower one on middle, Hasaranga plays it with soft hands towards mid on and takes two. A good over by Rance, 8 runs and a wicket from it.
Wanindu Hasaranga comes out to bat next.

OUT! Another one bites the dust! Seth Rance gets another. Big wicket as Dickwella was well-set. Sri Lanka losing their way here. Dickwella moves right across and Seth Rance bowls it fast and full on middle. Dickwella misses the flick shot and gets hit on the pads. An appeal and up goes the finger. No reviews but it would not have mattered. A good innings by Dickwella comes to an end but he needed to stay longer. New Zealand can now keep Sri Lanka under 155.
A yorker on middle, Dickwella jams it out towards deep mid-wicket and a couple is taken.
Comes down the track and absolutely smashes it down to mid off but only for one.
Slower one and on middle, Dickwella mistimes his pull through mid-wicket for one.
That is some shot! Not sure if it was intended! Dickwella initially looks to reverse paddle scoop it but it goes off the inner half through backward square leg for two.
Seth Rance is back!
A dot to end! Shorter and outside off, SJ looks to cut but is beaten. He looks at the umpire for a wide but not given.
FOUR! Smashed! This is full and outside off, Jayasuriya clears his front leg and smashes it through covers for a boundary.
Dickwella continues to take risks. He plays the paddle scoop down to fine leg for one.
Leg bye! This is on the pads, Jayasuriya looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. It goes down to fine leg for one.
Very full and on off, this is hit to covers.
Shehan Jayasuriya is the new man in.

OUT! No inside edge and Shanaka is a goner! That is as plumb as it gets. Not sure why he reviewed. Sri Lanka lose their only one. This is very full and on middle, Shanaka walks across and looks to flick but misses. It is too quick for him. He is hit flush on the pads. An appeal and up goes the finger. Dasun starts walking back but then reviews. Replays roll in and they show the on-field call is the right one. New Zealand are back in the game with two quick wickets. A first-baller for Shanaka.
Shanaka is a goner! He reviews. If no inside edge, it is plumb.
Scott Kuggeleijn is back on! 2-0-20-0 so far from him.
A dot to end a successful over for New Zealand. Shorter and outside off, Dickwella looks to cut again but misses.
A couple! Shorter and outside off, Dickwella hits it wide of the fielder at deep point for two.
Dasun Shanaka is the new man in.

OUT! In the air... taken! That is a superb catch from Santner. Something special was needed to break this stand and Santner delivers. Outstanding! Southee gets the breakthrough. A much-needed one. The ploy to get himself back into the attack pays off. Southee cleverly bowls this wide outside off and it is the slower one. Fernando reaches out for it but is a touch early in the shot. It goes off the toe end and to the left of the wicket. It seems like it would fall safe but Santner runs in from covers, dives forward and takes it. Once again pin-drop silence here in the stadium. However, this was a top stand as it has laid the foundation for the batters coming in.
FOUR! Picked his spot nicely there! Fernando comes down the track and Southee bangs it short. Fernando manages to flat-bat it over the mid on fielder for a boundary. Raining boundaries at the moment.
Direct hit and the batter was a goner! Shorter and outside off, the batter mistimes it towards cover and takes off. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
Swing and a miss! Slower one and outside off, Dickwella looks to swing but misses.
Tim Southee is back on! 2-0-8-0 so far from him.
Two to end! 14 from the over. A huge one. Sri Lanka on top now. This is shorter and outside off, Mendis cuts it past point for two.

SIX! That is the shorter side and he clears it. This is flatter and angled into the pads. Fernando brings the slog sweep out and connects it really well. Clears the square leg fence. 100 up for Sri Lanka with this maximum.
Slower through the air outside off, Fernando hits it wide of long on and takes two.
Well played again! Fires it outside off, Dickwella hits it down to long on for one.
A couple now! Dickwella dances down the track again, it is bowled shorter. ND pulls it through mid-wicket. It is in the gap and two is taken.
50-run stand up! A vital one as Sri Lanka were in trouble when the two came together. Fernando comes down the track and eases it down to long on for one.
Mitchell Santner is back! 3-0-20-0 so far.
Safe again! Fernando uses his feet and looks to go against the turn to this tossed up ball. He ends up mistiming it but the ball falls safe in the long on region for one.
Dickwella steps out and hits it down to long off for one.
Shorter and it  skids through on the pads, Fernando lofts it over the mid-wicket fielder. It goes on the bounce to the deep mid-wicket fielder for one.
Loopy ball on middle, this is eased down to long off.

FOUR! Over the bowler's head and runs are flowing here now. Dickwella uses his feet and Sodhi bowls it wide outside off. Dickwella drags it towards long on. The fielder there is wide and hence, it is a boundary.
Almost done in flight there. Plays it well in the end. Fernando steps out and Sodhi floats it up. Fernando realizes he is beaten in flight so gently pushes it down to long off for one.
Ish Sodhi is back on! His figures so far 2-0-14-1
Back of a length ball on off, Fernando punches it to cover and keeps the strike. Another expensive over from Kuggeleijn. 11 off this one. 20 off his 2.

FOUR! Smashed! Dickwella loves to play pacers and this shot shows why. Overpitched ball on off and middle, Dickwella clears his front leg and smashes it straight down the ground for a boundary. The fielder at long off had no chance stopping that.
On the pads, Dickwella looks to flick but the ball goes off his thigh pad towards fine leg for a single.

FOUR! Terrible effort in the field from Rance. Slower bouncer around the body. Dickwella pulls it through backward square leg. Rance comes running in from fine leg and looks to stop it with a slide but the ball goes through him for a boundary.
Length ball outside leg, Dickwella makes room but hits it straight to cover.
Good length ball on middle, Avishka looks to drive it on the off side but it goes to the on side off the inside edge for a single.
Scott Kuggeleijn is back on now!
The physio is out in the middle for Niroshan Dickwella. Seems like he has some issue on his right thigh. However, he is back up and looks fine to continue.
A dot to end another good over for Sri Lanka. This is flatter and outside off, Dickwella looks to guide it down to third man but misses.

SIX! Going, going and gone! That is a top shot from Dickwella! He comes down the track and hits it with the turn. It is right off the middle so despite it being the longer part of the ground, he clears the mid-wicket fence.
Beautiful bowling! Fernando comes down the track but Santner slows it up and lands it on off. Fernando pushes it to covers and takes one.
Angles it on middle and then gets it to straighten. Fernando blocks it out.
Flatter and shorter on off, Dickwella slaps it down to long off for one more.

NOT OUT! Dickwella is well in! Not sure why the umpire went upstairs. Dickwella once again plays the reverse sweep and hits it through point. They take one and go for the second. Guptill picks the ball up and fires it to the keeper who whips the bails off and appeals. The umpire takes it upstairs. Replays  show that Dickwella is well in.
An appeal for a run out has been taken upstairs. New Zealand do not seem confident.
A single to end a good over for Lanka! Once again, Dickwella plays a risky shot. He comes down the track and hits it uppishly but wide of the bowler and down to long on for one.
On middle, it is worked to mid-wicket.

DROPPED AGAIN AND FOUR! This one was a straightforward chance! The reverse sweep comes out. Dickwella had to drag it from the leg pole. Hence, it goes towards cover. Bruce there tries to catch it but the ball bursts through his hands and goes to the cover fence. Bruce was the culprit. Not a good start for the man who just came into the team. Another life for Dickwella. Is it his day today? Night I should ask.
A single after the boundary! Good batting. This is full and on off, it is hit down to long off for one.
FOUR! 50 up for Sri Lanka! A much-needed boundary for them. Fernando once again uses his feet and stays leg side of the ball. He smashes it through covers and it races away.

Dickwella misses out there! It is short and on the pads, Dickwella looks to pull but misses. It hits the pad and rolls towards short fine leg for one. The bowler appeals but the umpire would never give that out. Leg bye signaled!

Dropped! A very tough chance though. Dickwella comes down the track but does not get to the pitch of it. He still swings but it goes off the inner half to the left of Santner. He stretches his left hand out but the ball hits the finger tips and goes down to long on for one.
Well bowled! An in-drifter! It starts from outside off and comes back in. Fernando pushes it through covers for one.
Just short and then a misfield! This is floated up on off, Fernando stays leg side of the delivery and hits it towards cover. It lands just short, goes through the hands of that fielder for two.
Slower through the air outside off, Dickwella sweeps it nicely through square leg for one.
Dickwella comes down the track but gets too close to the pitch of the ball. He hits it back to the bowler.
Fired on middle, the batter pushes it down to long off for one.
Slower through the air on middle, Dickwella works it to mid-wicket. A very nice start by Sodhi.
Shorter and outside off, it is guided through point for one.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed to the man at covers.
A single now as Dickwella works it through square leg and takes one. He gets off the mark.
Niroshan Dickwella makes his way out to the middle.

OUT! Chops it on! Sodhi strikes in his first over. Pin-drop silence here in the stadium. All of a sudden, Sri Lanka are in trouble here. Sodhi bowls it outside off, Perera looks to play the sweep shot but the ball stays slightly slow. The batter gets an inside edge onto the off pole. Another low score for Perera.
Gentle loosener on the pads, Perera works it to mid-wicket for a couple.
Ish Sodhi comes on now!

Yes, he can! This is flatter and on off, once again it straightens. AF looks to push it but it goes off the outside edge to short third man. Just the 4 runs off the 6th. New Zealand have managed to pull things back brilliantly. Sri Lanka are 38 for 1 after 6.
Turn and pace! Unplayable! This is flatter and on off, it pitches and spins away. Fernando looks to defend but gets beaten. This is a top class sixth over till now, can he end it well?
In the air... but safe! Perera mistiming that one saves him there. This is very full and on middle, he looks to swat it but ends up mistiming it towards long on for one.
On off, Fernando pushes it down to long off again and gets to the other end.
Flatter and on middle, it is worked through mid-wicket and a single is taken.
Fernando is off the mark! This is eased down to long off for one.
Mitchell Santner is on now! He will bowl the last over of the Powerplay.
Avishka Fernando comes out next to bat. Can he play a good knock here for his team?

OUT! In the air... taken! Rance draws first blood. A big wicket this as Mendis once again looked on song. It has been a tremendous comeback after going for a boundary on the first ball. Just the two runs after that and a wicket. This is a lovely slower one on off, Mendis is completely deceived. He is way too early in the shot. Ends up hitting it straight up in the air towards mid off. Southee takes it nicely. The good looking opening stand is put to a stop.
Extremely full and on off, Mendis looks to drive but it goes off the bottom to cover.
Nice slower one on middle, Perera works it towards mid on for one.
A leg bye! This is on the pads, Mendis looks to flick but misses. It hits him on the pads and lobs on the leg side. A quick run is taken.
Good length and on off, Mendis strokes it to covers.

FOUR! Deft! That is very nicely played! Smart batting! Just used the pace of the bowler. It is on a length and around off, Mendis plays it very late, he guides it past short third man and bags a boundary. He looks in fine, fine touch once again.
Change of ends for Seth Rance.
In the air but on the bounce! Shorter and around off, Perera looks to smash it but ends up slicing it short of mid off. 10 from the over, expensive start from SK too.
Once again a full toss but not taken full toll of. Mendis mistimes his drive to mid on for one.
SIX! Do not bowl short to Mendis, he will put away! Second six off a pull shot. This is on the body, Mendis helps it on its way and clears the backward square leg fence with ease.
This is fuller and on middle, Mendis strokes it to mid on.
Mendis looks to innovate as he tries to paddle it. Misses. The keeper appeals but nothing from the umpire.

A misfield and three! This is a yorker outside off, the batter jams it towards point. The point fielder and the backward point fielder both go for it but none of them stop it and the batters take three.
Scott Kuggeleijn is on now!
Another single! One more full toss on middle, it tails back in. It is worked through square leg for one. Just the 4 singles from the over.
One more slower one on middle, Mendis waits for it and pulls it through square leg for one.
Shortish and on off, Mendis initially looks to pull but the ball skids through. Mendis ends up defending it onto the ground.
A slower one on the pads, Perera works it wide of short fine leg and gets to the other end.
Southee gets away with one now! This is shorter and on the body, should be easy pickings with fine leg up. Mendis though mistimes his pull through square leg for one.
Outside off and it is on a length. Mendis looks to guide it late down to third man but misses.

Good running between the wickets by both the Sri Lankan openers. Length delivery and outside off, Mendis defends it towards point and calls for a quick single. The duo is quick to get to their respective ends.
Rance errs in line and bowls one on the pads, Mendis flicks it to mid-wicket for a couple.
Corrects his line and  bowls on a length, Mendis looks to run it down to third man but gets it off the outer half of his bat to backward point.

SIX! What a hit! This is the sign of a man in form. Rance goes short and Mendis takes full toll of it as he gets on his back foot and hits it over the cow corner fence for a maximum. First Six of the game.
On a length and outside off, Mendis plays it straight to mid off.
Rance starts with a poor delivery. He starts with a full toss on the body and Perera fails to get under it. He can only get it to mid-wicket for a single.
Seth Rance to bowl from the other end. He did not have a very good first game but has a chance to make amends here.
A lovely deceptive slower one to end! It is full and outside off, Mendis is a touch early as he tries to hit it downtown. Beaten. A good first over by Southee comes to an end.
Good bowling! Gets this one to jag back in after landing it behind a length on off. Mendis looks to flick but misses to get hit high on the pads.
A slash and a miss! This is shorter and outside off, Mendis looks to cut but is beaten by the extra bounce.
Shortens his length this time and lands it on off, Mendis defends it onto the ground.

FOUR! That is some shot to get off the mark! It is full and on middle, it is shaping away. Mendis works it against the movement and flicks it through mid-wicket. The ball races away to the fence. It was a risky shot but he hit it to perfection.
Swing first up for Southee! This is on off and then it moves away. Mendis watches it carefully and shoulders arms to it.

We are all set for the action to begin! The New Zealand players make their way out to the middle. They are followed by the Sri Lankan openers, Kusal Perera and Kusal Mendis. Tim Southee to start proceedings for the visitors. Here we go...

New Zealand skipper, Tim Southee, says it is a new start tonight on a different surface and a chance for the players to deliver again. States Ross Taylor and Colin de Grandhomme were brilliant and the youngsters finished it off well in the last game. Informs Ross Taylor is injured and he sits out, Tom Bruce comes in for him.

Sri Lanka skipper, Lasith Malinga, says it is a young team and they don't want to bat with pressure and they back themselves to defend what they put up. States being the first one to get to 100 T20I wickets is a big thing and he is happy about it and he wants to continue his good performance for his side. Informs there is one change for them, Rajitha sits out and Sandakan comes in.

PITCH REPORT - Kyle Mills says it is the replica of the wicket they saw a couple of days ago and it is very hard but there are a lot of cracks. Ends by saying there will be swing with the new ball but not a lot of carry, just like the first game.

NEW ZEALAND (PLAYING XI) - Martin Guptill, Colin Munro, Tim Seifert (WK), Tom Bruce (IN FOR ROSS TAYLOR), Daryl Mitchell, Colin de Grandhomme, Mitchell Santner, Scott Kuggeleijn, Tim Southee (C), Seth Rance, Ish Sodhi.

SRI LANKA (PLAYING XI) - Kusal Mendis, Kusal Perera (WK), Avishka Fernando, Niroshan Dickwella, Dasun Shanaka, Shehan Jayasuriya, Isuru Udana, Wanindu Hasaranga, Lasith Malinga (C), Akila Dananjaya, Lakshan Sandakan (IN FOR KASUN RAJITHA).
TOSS - Up goes the coin and it lands in the favor of Sri Lanka. THEY WILL BAT FIRST AGAIN!

Hello and welcome to the second match of the three match T20I series between Sri Lanka and New Zealand. The Kiwis are leading the series by 1-0 and would look to seal the series today. Sri Lanka on the other hand would look to level the series and spice up the contest further. We had a cracker of a game in the first T20I, hope we get a similar one today too. So do join us in a while for the toss.
